html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

This patch introduces the Lord of Hell 
and the Son of Satan.

 

Mephisto, a malevolent soul collector with supernatural powers, 
and Hellstorm, who possesses both human and demonic natures and wields the power of hell, 
have received Tier-4 Advancements and New Uniforms.

 

Agents, check out the new skills and power of the updated heroes
by downloading the 9/2 Patch!

 


■ 9/2 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 9/3 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 9/2 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[9/3 (Wed) 2:40 (UTC+0), 9/2 (Tue) 19:40 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 9/3 (Wed) 2:39 (UTC+0), 9/2 (Tue) 19:39 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms


The two new Uniforms, Mephisto <Master of Hell>, Hellstorm <TVA>, have been added.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <Lord of Hell Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

* To celebrate the release of Mephisto's New Uniform, a 10% discount coupon for the Agent Supplies is being distributed. 
- Coupon acquisition and usage period:
 9/2 (Tue) 15:00 - 9/16 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
 9/2 (Tue) 8:00 - 9/16 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

 

 

 


▣ Mephisto & Hellstorm Tier-4

 

Mephisto, who grants wishes to corrupt people and gain power, 
and Hellstorm, who constantly struggles with his identity as the Son of Satan while fighting for good, 
have received Tier-4 Advancements.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 


▣ New Artifact

 

After the September patch, an Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Mephisto will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes


1. Doctor Voodoo <Savage Avengers>: Changed the name of the 3rd skill for a specific language.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. Fixed an issue where the 2nd and 3rd hero equipment images for Black Knight were displayed incorrectly.


2. Legendary Battle (Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Infinity War): Fixed an issue in the “The Final Battle" stage where using a skill too quickly at the start of the battle would cause the character to be defeated by Thanos's cinematic attack.


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
